name: form-sheet
title: Form sheet
description: A side sheet built for editing: header and footer in view, a scrolling body with edge shadows, a Discard changes? guard, and a problem summary after a failed save.
docs: onSubmit receives the form's FormData. To fail, return a list of { field, message } or throw an Error: the sheet stays open with a summary at the top and focus on the first invalid field, so mark invalid controls aria-invalid="true". dirty makes closing by the corner button, Cancel, Escape or the backdrop ask Discard changes? first, and Keep editing puts focus back where it was. While onSubmit is pending (or pending is true) the fields, which sit in one fieldset, and the close button are locked, and the Save button says it is busy. side is right or left on a wide screen and a bottom sheet on a phone.
